theorems.name: Submission.slicing_mb_pointwise_liminf_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (a : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (LW : ℝ≥0) (r : ℝ), (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ X : ℝ → ℝ, Tendsto X (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 r) ∧ ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → ENNReal.ofReal |X h| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + ε) / h) * (LW : ℝ≥0∞) * a h) → ENNReal.ofReal |r| ≤ (LW : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => a h / ENNReal.ofReal h) (𝓝[>] 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
